name: Louise Bowman
researchFocus: Large-scale clinical trials in cardiovascular disease, especially in diabetes; Chief Investigator of the ORION-4 and AMALFI trials, with a specialist interest in clinical trials methodology to improve the design and conduct of trials.
title: Professor of Medicine and Clinical Trials

name: Sarah Pendlebury
researchFocus: The short- and long-term impact of acute illness and cerebrovascular disease on the ageing brain, including dementia after TIA/stroke, delirium and frailty, studied through large real-world cohorts such as ORCHARD-PS and ORCHARD-EPR.
title: Professor of Medicine and Old Age Neuroscience

name: Jean Abraham
researchFocus: Innovative clinical trials in high-risk and hereditary early-stage breast cancers, and using multi-modal data integration to develop predictive and prognostic tools that personalise breast cancer treatment and improve outcomes.
title: Professor of Precision Breast Cancer Medicine

name: Catherine Aiken
researchFocus: Understanding and optimising the long-term outcomes of medically complex pregnancies, for example those affected by placental insufficiency or maternal cardiovascular disease, using data linkage (the POPStar mother-and-child platform) and placental models.
title: Professor of Maternal and Fetal Medicine

name: Anne Becker
researchFocus: The social and cultural mediation of presentation and risk for eating disorders, social barriers to care for mental disorders, and school-based mental health promotion, including studies in Fiji, Haiti and Lebanon.
title: Maude and Lillian Presley Professor of Global Health and Social Medicine

name: Anjala Tess
researchFocus: Quality and safety in hospital medicine; she developed a novel quality-improvement curriculum that has trained over 500 residents and fellows and directs the Harvard Medical School Patient Safety and Quality Fellowship.
title: Associate Professor of Medicine

name: Gari D. Clifford
researchFocus: Machine learning in healthcare, wearable and ambient sensors, physiological monitoring and critical care informatics, translating high-frequency clinical data into real-time decision support and early warning systems.
title: Professor of Anesthesiology and Critical Care Medicine

name: Michael A. Rosen
researchFocus: Human factors psychology applied to healthcare, as a professor in the Johns Hopkins School of Medicine with joint appointments in the Schools of Public Health and Nursing.
title: Professor of Medicine

name: Jodie McVernon
researchFocus: Public health physician and epidemiologist specialising in clinical vaccine trials, epidemiologic studies and mathematical modelling of infectious diseases to inform immunisation and pandemic preparedness policy in Australia and the Western Pacific.
title: Professor and Director of Doherty Epidemiology

name: Rosemary McKenzie
researchFocus: Health service evaluation and research, including the safety and quality of telehealth, clinical governance, primary care policy, health promotion and healthy ageing, leading national and state evaluations.
title: Professor of Public Health

name: Maree Teesson
researchFocus: Mental health and substance use disorders, in particular the comorbidity between them, and their prevention, early intervention and treatment, including school-based digital programs reaching hundreds of thousands of students.
title: Distinguished Professor and Director of the Matilda Centre

name: Gemma Figtree
researchFocus: Preventing heart attacks by innovating silent coronary artery disease detection and treatment, exploring mechanisms of heart attack susceptibility and response from bench research to clinical trials.
title: Professor of Medicine

name: Rachel Chambers
researchFocus: Elucidating the signalling pathways and transcriptional networks underlying the development of lung inflammation and fibrosis, as Director of the UCL Centre for Inflammation and Tissue Repair.
title: Professor of Respiratory Cell and Molecular Biology

name: Sam Janes
researchFocus: Airway homeostasis and the earliest development of lung cancer; chief investigator of SUMMIT, the largest lung cancer screening trial in Europe, and of first-in-man trials of cell and gene therapies for lung disease.
title: Professor of Respiratory Medicine

name: Allison McGeer
researchFocus: Prevention of infection in hospitals and nursing homes, and the use of surveillance to advance the prevention, diagnosis and treatment of infectious diseases, as principal investigator of the Toronto Invasive Bacterial Diseases Network.
title: Professor of Medicine (Infectious Diseases)

name: Diego Delgado
researchFocus: Immunologic aspects of heart failure and cardiac transplantation, myocardial recovery after mechanical assist devices, and decision analysis in cardiac transplantation.
title: Professor of Medicine (Cardiology)
